description: Systematic error handling across both the sync command and set-folder-dates companion script. Defines exit code semantics: 0 for success, 1 for runtime errors (missing token, API failure, clone/pull failure, missing root path), 2 for usage errors (unknown flags, repeated positional args). Top-level catch in cli.ts handles unexpected errors with process.exit(1).
spec:
1. Verify sync exits code 0 when all repos sync successfully.
2. Verify sync exits code 1 when GITHUB_TOKEN is missing.
3. Verify sync exits code 1 when the GitHub API fetch fails.
4. Verify sync exits code 1 when any clone or pull operation fails.
5. Verify sync exits code 2 when unknown CLI arguments are provided.
6. Verify set-folder-dates exits code 1 when the target directory does not exist.
7. Verify set-folder-dates exits code 2 when unknown CLI arguments are provided.
8. Verify cli.ts catches unexpected errors and exits code 1.
title: Error Handling and Exit Codes
